chars.SOFIANE: SOFIANE: a slim young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, light-blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.ZAKARIA: ZAKARIA: a young man wearing a forest-green bomber jacket over a black t-shirt, black joggers and red sneakers.
chars.ABDO: ABDO: a stocky older man wearing a black leather jacket over a white shirt, a thick gold chain, sunglasses pushed up on his head, dark trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a small student apartment in Granada, Spain, SOFIANE happily zips up an open suitcase on a bed while ZAKARIA folds clothes next to him, both excited to travel home to Morocco. Window shows Granada rooftops.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At an outdoor café table on a Granada street at evening, ABDO leans forward with a friendly but sly smile, one hand raised as if asking a favor, while SOFIANE listens attentively holding a coffee cup.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: On a Granada street at night, ABDO puts a hand on SOFIANE's shoulder like a big brother, grinning; SOFIANE nods politely and gives a thumbs up, a bit naive.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SOFIANE and ZAKARIA walk with their rolling suitcases along the seaside in Safi, Morocco, with the old Portuguese fortress walls and the Atlantic ocean behind them, sunny day, both smiling.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On a rooftop terrace in Safi, ZAKARIA frowns suspiciously at SOFIANE, arms crossed, one eyebrow raised, while SOFIANE explains with open hands.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan café in Safi with mint tea glasses on the table, SOFIANE shrugs casually and smiles to reassure ZAKARIA, who still looks unconvinced, leaning back in his chair.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At night in a Moroccan family living room with traditional sofas, SOFIANE sits holding his glowing phone that keeps buzzing with calls, looking tired and annoyed.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In a bedroom in Safi, SOFIANE stands next to a half-packed suitcase staring nervously at his phone, sweat drop on his head, tense mood, dim evening light through the window.
